name: fixedbg-imagemasking
title: Fixed Background Image Mask
blurb: Fixed background image masked to an SVG shape.
description: Hero section with a fixed background image clipped by SVG mask at /splash-center.svg. Background stays pinned while page scrolls.
use_when: Large hero sections where a distinctive masked shape with a pinned background creates visual impact.
avoid_when: When the SVG mask asset is unavailable, or on browsers without mask-image support.
a11y: Background image is purely decorative with no semantic content.
